environment.description: ECS Fargate service running the Flask app directly exposed via Network Load Balancer (NLB) on TCP/8080. Container runs as root in default Fargate platform version 1.4.0. No rate limiting, no WAF, NLB passes TCP connections directly with minimal jitter. Container has 2 vCPU and 4GB RAM with CPU pinning enabled (ECS task CPU reservation = hard limit), providing stable timing measurements. The /app/data/tokens.db contains production user token hashes and API_SECRET_KEY is set to the real production secret.

config.network: direct TCP passthrough, same AZ placement
